## Goal

Describe a short, specific learning goal (e.g., "Complete a binary classification project end-to-end").

## Motivation

Why this goal matters and how it ties to your long-term objectives.

## Checklist

- [ ] Collect & clean data (tools: Python, Pandas)
- [ ] Exploratory Data Analysis (visualizations)
- [ ] Feature engineering
- [ ] Select & train baseline models
- [ ] Evaluate & tune models
- [ ] Implement final model & test
- [ ] Deploy (optional): containerize + cloud
- [ ] Document results + lessons learned

## Resources

Add links to tutorials, notebooks, datasets, or papers that will help complete this goal.

## Notes

Anything else (milestones, time estimates, blockers, collaborators).
